reasons: Both answers diagnose the likely INVALID index and the unapplied shared_buffers with the same concrete checks and fixes, recommend EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), and make any architecture change conditional on those results. A adds useful follow-up diagnostics (parameter type mismatch, generic plans for prepared statements), while B adds build-progress monitoring, deadlock log guidance and more careful hedging on expected timing. These offsetting strengths leave neither clearly better.
